name: Ranger Capsule 12
about: Ranger Capsule 12 (1962 ALP, NASA/JPL), launched 1962 Jan 26. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Luna, Earth. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
